label: About
title: About Nocturne Registration Atlas
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @levelsio: When I set up a new Hetzner VPS first thing I do install Tailscale and once I'm in... and @pizzaboy: With a recent client, I tested a new internal tool, which is like Tinder but for..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Nocturne Registration Atlas: Nocturne archive-scan registration atlas, a diagrammatic fold seen in overhead scan: a hard filing grid of receipt meridians and folder blocks is split by one impossible folded legal-form aperture. Scanner-glass glare, translucent preservation film, graphite OCR seams, manila stock, and server-metal nodes make two h... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central folded legal-form aperture around cyan crosshair, long vertical receipt and barcode strips, and black brushed-metal custody rails with pinholes.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
